action_items: No API-bearing criteria in this matrix (static portfolio, no login/backend data) - no backend pytest lane required.

7 acceptance criteria in briefing covered by 18 checks total (5 new + 1 rewritten obsolete check + 12 regression re-runs); matrix size is under the 8-criterion threshold so full coverage was completed without a count note.

project-presentation check was rewritten: the previous version asserted a placeholder still existed for the Wireflow project, which contradicts this iteration's briefing (all three projects now ship real assets, zero placeholders). New version asserts zero '-visual-placeholder' testids remain and all three real carousels render.

checks.name: wireflow-carousel-real-assets
checks.evidence: 5 dots present, counter starts 01/05, all 5 slide images confirmed loaded (complete && naturalWidth>0) while cycling with next-button, dot-5 jumps to 05/05, next wraps circularly to 01/05. At 390px mobile viewport, touch swipe left advanced 01/05->02/05 and swipe right wrapped back to 01/05.

checks.name: fullscreen-preview-modal-three-projects
checks.evidence: For sport4all, pdam, and wireflow: expand-button opens fullscreen-dialog showing correct project title/number, loaded fullscreen-image, counter, previous/next arrow buttons, and close-button which closes dialog. Also confirmed clicking the carousel image itself (fullscreen-open-button) opens the same modal for sport4all.

checks.name: fullscreen-keyboard-controls
checks.evidence: On pdam fullscreen dialog: ArrowRight 01/05->02/05, ArrowLeft 02/05->01/05, ArrowLeft wraps to 05/05, ArrowRight wraps back to 01/05 (circular), Escape closes the dialog (dialog becomes hidden).

checks.name: fullscreen-mobile-swipe-containment
checks.evidence: At 390x844 viewport: wireflow fullscreen dialog boundingBox stays within [0,391] x-range (no horizontal overflow, document.scrollWidth<=clientWidth), touch swipe left on the image advanced 01/05->02/05, swipe right returned to 01/05, and close-button remained clickable and closed the dialog.

checks.name: project-lime-accent-outline
checks.evidence: For sport4all, pdam, wireflow carousel containers: computed borderColor contains rgb(212, 255, 63) (the --lime token), boxShadow non-empty (soft lime glow), borderWidth between 0 and 2px (thin outline) confirming subtle lime accent without obscuring images.

checks.name: project-visual-compact-sizing
checks.evidence: Desktop (1280px): all three carousel boundingBox heights <=390px. Mobile (390px): all three heights <=360px. No horizontal document overflow at mobile width. No text overlap observed in screenshots.

checks.name: hero-portfolio-identity
checks.evidence: Rerun persisted check passed: greeting, full name, headline, CTA, profile photo frame, AVAILABLE FOR PKL and OPEN TO NEW IDEAS badges present and non-overlapping.

checks.name: hero-profile-photo-quality
checks.evidence: Rerun persisted check passed: profile photo loaded (complete && naturalWidth>0), portrait crop confirmed, PKL badge does not intersect face zone.

checks.name: sport4all-carousel-desktop
checks.evidence: Rerun persisted check passed: 4 dots, counter cycling via next/dot/previous, all slide images loaded.

checks.name: sport4all-carousel-mobile
checks.evidence: Rerun persisted check passed: carousel fits within 390px viewport, no horizontal overflow before/after next-button.

checks.name: pill-navigation-anchor-flow
checks.evidence: Rerun persisted check passed: NV monogram, all four desktop nav links, anchor URLs/sections, active-state assertions intact.

checks.name: mobile-navigation-project-flow
checks.evidence: Rerun persisted check passed: desktop links hidden on mobile, hamburger opens menu, Project link navigates to #project, menu closes.

checks.name: about-and-skills-content
checks.evidence: Rerun persisted check passed for RPL/UI/UX copy and Figma, Canva, CapCut, Adobe Illustrator, Lightroom skill groups.

checks.name: contact-actions
checks.evidence: Rerun persisted check passed: email text/mailto link and LinkedIn/GitHub destination links intact.

checks.name: responsive-stability
checks.evidence: Rerun persisted mobile check passed: menu usability, project navigation, no horizontal overflow before/after navigation.

checks.name: pdam-carousel-desktop
checks.evidence: Rerun persisted check passed: 5 dots, counter cycling via next/dot/previous, all 5 PDAM screenshots loaded.

checks.name: pdam-swipe-circular
checks.evidence: Rerun persisted check passed: touch swipe left/right cycles circularly with no horizontal overflow.

checks.name: sport4all-swipe-circular
checks.evidence: Rerun persisted check passed: touch swipe left/right cycles circularly with no horizontal overflow.

checks.name: project-presentation
checks.evidence: Rewritten to match current spec: project-list visible, all three real carousels (sport4all/pdam/wireflow) visible, zero elements matching '[data-testid$="-visual-placeholder"]' confirming no placeholders remain project-wide.
